disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 审查了本机控制面（/dsh-reverse-proxy/*）：仅要求回环来源与固定控制头，无调用者认证，检出风险见 FND-001；作者在开发文档中已记录该限制（docs/roadmap.zh.md:85）。

checked_items.en: Reviewed the client injection logic: the script injected into the index page wraps the module loader and sets the connection handle's isLoopback to true (src/page-bootstrap.ts), used for remote-page settings persistence, part of the plugin's declared remote-access feature; this flag only affects client UI behavior, while the backend trust barrier is still enforced by the proxy's token/session authentication.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务上挂载控制路由 /dsh-reverse-proxy/*（src/control.ts:10、src/control-routes.ts:161-176），仅校验回环来源与固定控制头 x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control: 1，无调用者认证；本机任意进程可操纵代理，详见 FND-001。
evidence.en: The plugin mounts the control route /dsh-reverse-proxy/* on the host web service (src/control.ts:10, src/control-routes.ts:161-176), checking only the loopback source and the fixed control header x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control: 1, with no caller authentication; any local process can manipulate the proxy, see FND-001.

title.zh: 本机回环控制面无调用者认证，本地进程可操纵代理并取得远程访问
title.en: The local loopback control plane has no caller authentication; local processes can manipulate the proxy and obtain remote access.

description.zh:
插件把控制 API 挂在宿主 Web 服务上，路由前缀为 /dsh-reverse-proxy/*（src/control.ts:10），校验仅三项：来源为回环地址、请求头 x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control: 1、Origin 为回环或缺失（src/control-routes.ts:161-176）。控制头是公开常量（src/control.ts:10-12），不是秘密；除 GET /token 受 allowTokenRead（默认 false）单独把关外，start/stop/rotate-token/listen/tunnel/start/invite/sessions/approve/revoke/audit 等操作均无需任何凭据（src/control-routes.ts:91-159）。

控制面只监听回环，公网代理对 /dsh-reverse-proxy/* 一律 403（src/proxy.ts:703-707），因此风险面限定在本机进程。作者已在开发文档记录同类限制（docs/roadmap.zh.md:85：「回环 HTTP 本就没有调用者身份」），并列入 Known Limitations。
description.en:
The plugin mounts the control API on the host web service with route prefix /dsh-reverse-proxy/* (src/control.ts:10). The checks are only three: the source is a loopback address, the request header x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control: 1 is present, and the Origin is loopback or missing (src/control-routes.ts:161-176). The control header is a public constant (src/control.ts:10-12), not a secret; except for GET /token which is separately gated by allowTokenRead (default false), operations such as start/stop/rotate-token/listen/tunnel/start/invite/sessions/approve/revoke/audit require no credentials at all (src/control-routes.ts:91-159).

The control plane listens only on loopback, and the public proxy returns 403 for /dsh-reverse-proxy/* (src/proxy.ts:703-707), so the risk surface is limited to local processes. The author has documented the same limitation in the development docs (docs/roadmap.zh.md:85: "loopback HTTP inherently has no caller identity") and listed it in Known Limitations.

evidence.zh: src/control-routes.ts:161-176：if (!isLoopbackHost(req.socket.remoteAddress ?? '')) → 403；if (req.headers[CONTROL_HEADER] !== CONTROL_HEADER_VALUE || !isLoopbackOrigin(req.headers.origin)) → 403。src/control.ts:10-12：CONTROL_HEADER = 'x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control'，CONTROL_HEADER_VALUE = '1'。src/control-routes.ts:106-112：GET /token 仅在 allowTokenRead 为 true 时放行，其余写操作路由（:91-159）无凭证校验。docs/roadmap.zh.md:85：作者自述「本机任意进程（含其他 OS 用户）一条 curl 即可取走」。
evidence.en: src/control-routes.ts:161-176: if (!isLoopbackHost(req.socket.remoteAddress ?? '')) → 403; if (req.headers[CONTROL_HEADER] !== CONTROL_HEADER_VALUE || !isLoopbackOrigin(req.headers.origin)) → 403. src/control.ts:10-12: CONTROL_HEADER = 'x-dsh-reverse-proxy-control', CONTROL_HEADER_VALUE = '1'. src/control-routes.ts:106-112: GET /token is allowed only when allowTokenRead is true; the other write-route handlers (:91-159) have no credential verification. docs/roadmap.zh.md:85: the author states "any local process (including other OS users) can take it with a single curl".

impact.zh:
后果：本机任意进程（含其他 OS 用户，回环连接不受按用户访问控制限制）可无需凭据地启动/停止代理、轮换令牌（令所有远程会话失效）、改监听地址、开启公网隧道、生成一次性邀请、审批/踢出设备、读取设备 IP 与审计日志；在默认非审批模式下，可用生成的一次性邀请换取激活会话，再经公网隧道取得对宿主机 DeepSeek Harness 的完整远程访问（设置、凭据、文件浏览）。

触发条件：宿主机上存在任意本地进程（用户运行的程序、脚本或其他 OS 用户会话）即可发起回环 HTTP 请求；无需改动插件任何文件。

定级依据：这是插件作者已知并记录的设计取舍，无恶意证据，但攻击链完整且正常运行条件下可达，按 MEDIUM 收录（不改动插件文件即可触发的真实滥用路径），未升至 HIGH 因为前置条件是需要本机进程且非恶意意图。
impact.en:
Impact: any local process (including other OS users, since loopback connections are not subject to per-user access control) can, without credentials, start/stop the proxy, rotate tokens (invalidating all remote sessions), change the listening address, open a public tunnel, generate one-time invitations, approve/revoke devices, and read device IPs and audit logs; in the default non-approval mode, a generated one-time invitation can be exchanged for an active session, and then via the public tunnel obtain full remote access to the host's DeepSeek Harness (settings, credentials, file browsing).

Trigger condition: any local process on the host (a user-run program, script, or another OS user session) can initiate a loopback HTTP request; no modification to the plugin files is required.

Severity basis: this is a design trade-off known and documented by the author, with no malicious evidence, but the attack chain is complete and reachable under normal operating conditions; recorded as MEDIUM (a real abuse path triggerable without modifying plugin files). Not raised to HIGH because the prerequisite is a local process and no malicious intent.

limits.zh: 动态沙盒未启用（context 无 l4-sandbox.json），未做运行时验证；dsh 引擎版本取自 README 声明 0.1.1-rc.1（package.json 未显式声明 engines.dsh），能力声明（network/shell/fs/modelFacing）为依据代码实测推断（插件无显式能力清单）；未逐字通读的资源：pnpm-lock.yaml（约 197KB 锁文件）、全部图片、CSS 与构建/测试配置文件（tsconfig、vitest、eslint、tsdown）、发布笔记与截图脚本等文档类文件，已通过 manifest 清单核对存在性与哈希；context 目录无法用目录列举打开，但 static-scan-hits.json 与 manifest.json 均可读取，机械命中清单已逐条裁决完毕。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox was not enabled (context has no l4-sandbox.json), so runtime verification was not performed; the dsh engine version is taken from the README declaration 0.1.1-rc.1 (package.json does not explicitly declare engines.dsh); capability claims (network/shell/fs/modelFacing) are inferred from measured code (the plugin has no explicit capability list); resources not read word-for-word: pnpm-lock.yaml (~197KB lockfile), all images, CSS, and build/test config files (tsconfig, vitest, eslint, tsdown), release notes, screenshot scripts, and other documentation-type files; existence and hashes were verified against the manifest; the context directory could not be opened via directory listing, but static-scan-hits.json and manifest.json were readable, and the mechanical hit list was adjudicated in full.
